log.desc: Simulated printing: no physical printer connection; jobs are treated as printed. In image mode the label pictures are saved locally so you can check the output first.

tcp9100.desc: TCP 9100 network printer (Zebra etc.): sends commands to port 9100 of the printer IP; status queries use ~HS.

winspool.desc: Windows driver (USB / installed printers): sends commands via winspool in RAW mode; no printer IP needed.

labelframe-transport-zebra.desc: Zebra official Link-OS SDK: TCP / USB (auto-discovery) / Windows driver connections with printer status (Win10+, official plugin). In native command mode QR code data does not support Chinese (ASCII only); use a text box (image mode) for Chinese.
labelframe-transport-zebra.name: Zebra Brand Transport (official)

usbName.label: Zebra USB printer name
usbName.hint: Leave empty = auto-discover the first one

printMode.label: Print mode
printMode.hint: Native command mode has no preview; actual output depends on the printer. In this mode QR code data does not support Chinese (ASCII only); use a text box (image mode) for Chinese.

labelframe-transport-tspl.desc: TSPL command set direct connection (TSC and TSPL-compatible brands): TCP 9100 / USB driver-free direct connection with printer status (official plugin). In native command mode text does not support Chinese (the printer's built-in fonts have no CJK glyphs); use image mode for Chinese.
labelframe-transport-tspl.name: TSPL Command Set Transport (official)

usbName.label: USB printer name
usbName.hint: Leave empty = auto-discover the first one; fill in a VID (e.g. VID_1203) or device name

printMode.label: Print mode
printMode.hint: Native command mode has no preview; actual output depends on the printer. In this mode text does not support Chinese (the printer's built-in fonts have no CJK glyphs); use image mode for Chinese.

invertImage.label: Invert colors
invertImage.hint: Turn this on when image printing comes out with a black background (for compatible models whose bitmap polarity differs from TSC).
